For \(6 < n \le 30\), we have \(x=6\) and \(y=n-6\).

- \(x=2y\): \(6=2(n-6)\Rightarrow n=9\)
- \(y=2x\): \(n-6=12\Rightarrow n=18\)

For \(n>30\), we have \(x=6+(n-30)=n-24\) and \(y=24\).

- \(x=2y\): \(n-24=48\Rightarrow n=72\)
- \(y=2x\): \(24=2(n-24)\Rightarrow n=36\)

Thus the four possible values are \(9,18,36,72\), and their sum is

\[
9+18+36+72=135.
\]

\[
\boxed{135}
\]
